dedupe_keys.name: ofact open factory twin open source digital twin framework for production and logistics

description: Open Factory Twin (OFacT) is an open-source digital twin framework for production and logistics environments, released under the Apache 2.0 licence with documentation on a project site and a demo page at Fraunhofer ISST. The README states that it represents all relevant parts of a real system as a virtual model to support the design, planning and operational control of discrete material flow systems across their life cycle. It is motivated by shorter production life cycles, changing demand, complex supply chains, many product variants and regulation, which leave companies comparing many scenarios; detailed simulation models are often the only reliable way to evaluate costs and performance, and real-world data must be integrated regularly to keep them current. Coverage: single factories or logistics sites. Format and access: Python code with release notes and a quick start. Licence and cost: Apache 2.0, free. Caveats: aimed at intralogistics and production, not transport networks. It supports digital twin and capacity planning studies of warehouses, terminals and plants, such as disruption scenarios at a logistics node. It relates to FactorySimPy, AnyLogic and the SupplyTwin platform in the catalogue.
